subject: Production demo deep-dive — missed bridge, recovery plan and async runbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@horizon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Production demo deep-dive — prep, agenda and calendar invite

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking the time to schedule the production deep-dive for Horizon Analytics. I booked a 60-minute technical session for Wednesday, Apr 20 at 10:00am PT — invite attached. The goal is to walk through a short architecture map, validate latency/cost expectations for your 100k/day inference profile, and run a short hosted-to-dedicated routing demo.

Agenda (attached PDF):
- 10m introductions & context
- 20m architecture & integration checklist (networking, auth, data flow)
- 20m live demo: inference profile + fallback policy
- 10m next steps & rollout plan

If the time doesn't work for your eng team, propose alternative windows and we can move. Also attached is a one-page checklist that helps us validate network egress and auth before the session.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_demo_agenda_v2.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@horizon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production demo deep-dive — prep, agenda and calendar invite

On Wed, Apr 20, 2027 at 10:00 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Joining the call now — link in invite.

We were on the bridge for the scheduled time but no one from Horizon appeared. I waited ~10 minutes and tried the alternate eng bridge as well. Wanted to confirm you weren't able to join and check whether we should reschedule or run asynchronously.

We can do: 
- reschedule live (3 possible windows below)
- or run an asynchronous path: we record a 15–20m walk-through + supply an async runbook and short self-check scripts so your team can validate without coordinating calendars.

Proposed reschedule windows (PT):
- Thu Apr 22, 9:00–10:00
- Mon Apr 26, 11:00–12:00
- Tue Apr 27, 8:30–9:30

If you prefer async, we can publish: a short recorded demo, an "async runbook" doc with commands and sample logs, and a lightweight test harness your infra team can run (no Redwood credentials required beyond the test token).

Open to whatever is easiest for you — degraded bandwidth from your side is totally understandable.

Best,
Jordan

From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@horizon.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: eng-team@horizon.ai
Date: 2027-04-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production demo deep-dive — prep, agenda and calendar invite

Jordan — apologies, we had an unexpected all-hands at the same time and the eng leads couldn't make it. Totally our fault, and thanks for waiting.

We'd prefer the async route initially (our infra team is stretched this week). If you can provide a recorded walkthrough + a runbook (commands, sample dataset, expected latency/cost numbers) we'll run it against our staging cluster and follow up with any questions. If things look good, we can schedule a short follow-up live session to validate edge cases.

Preferable windows for a live catch-up next week if needed: Mon Apr 26 11–12 PT or Tue Apr 27 8:30–9:30 PT.

I'll loop in eng-team@horizon.ai and follow up with any immediate blockers after we try the async runbook.

Thanks again,
Alice Morgan
VP Engineering | Horizon Analytics

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@horizon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production demo deep-dive — prep, agenda and calendar invite

Perfect — thanks for the quick note, Alice. We'll pivot to the async plan. Action items from our side: 

1) We'll record a 15–20 minute walkthrough that covers the integration checklist and the live routing scenario.
2) We'll publish an Async-runbook-template.md in the Drive folder with step-by-step commands, sample input, and expected token/latency numbers.
3) Dev will build a small test harness (Docker + curl examples) so your infra can run the check in staging without additional credentials.

Deliverables & timeline:
- Recording (mp4) + runbook: by end of day Thu Apr 22 PT
- Test harness + sample logs: by Fri Apr 23 PT

I created a shared Drive folder for this engagement: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-demo-runbooks and I will upload the files there. HubSpot deal link: https://hubspot.com/deals/DEAL-8342

If you'd still like a live session after you try the runbook, I've tentatively held Mon Apr 26 11:00–11:30 PT on my calendar — no obligation, we can cancel if not needed.

Attachments: Async-runbook-template.md

Best,
Jordan

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Horizon async deliverables — who owns what

Marissa / Dev — quick internal note to align on deliverables for Horizon (DEAL-8342):

- Marissa: Own recording + speaker notes. Please include a two-slide summary at the top for execs (SLA, cost delta, recommended rollout). Deadline: Thu EOD PT.
- Dev: Build the test harness, include Dockerfile and a sample request script, and verify the expected 99th-pct latency under a small synthetic load. Put sample logs in the Drive folder. Deadline: Fri EOD PT.

I'll upload the agenda and a canned email template for the follow-up. Once we publish, I'll send Alice the Drive link and mark the tentative Mon slot as confirmed only if they ask.

Thanks — Jordan
